summary: ADR-0057 accepted 2026-08-05; stale catalog is a non-authorizing maintenance boundary, not publication permission; only maintain-knowledge-base may publish, via separate append-only request and explicit maintainer confirmation; request binds caller, trigger, one target plan, pinned local-main commit, non-automatic status, timestamp, knowledge-publication authority, and hash-verified Acceptance stale route; target must exist at pinned main; publish_knowledge_catalog.py --publish fails closed absent bindings; Acceptance emits/persists typed hash-bound stop route only within target plan; VDD/Acceptance require exactly one explicit target plan and reject knowledge outputs outside it; catalog indexes stable semantic plan sources, excluding authority manifests and knowledge contexts to break recursive freshness dependency; standalone builder is read-only; publication gate alone activates formal layers/pointers and bundle writer requires validated capability; versioned top-level requirements/ledger, implementation contract, plan state, and command registry select highest numeric version; read-only/historical compatibility retained; old generations need no retroactive request; new publications record request summary/hash; extends ADR-0044/0048/0050; supersedes none.
